what: Once, when the top edge of the photo box touches screen center — the photo starts as an 18-column mosaic, the cell count grows by (progress)^2.5 and it develops to original resolution in 1.5s, while settling from 1.1x to 1x

options.power: Exponent for cell count growth, default 2.5 — larger means everything sharpens at once at the end
options.steps: Set widths (px). Given like 160,300,400,600,1000, it redraws by jumping to those widths every every seconds and clears the canvas at the end (instead of curve and dur)
options.on: scroll (default) · load — once right on attach (after wait)
options.blocks: Instead of steps, cell sizes in px — given like ‹44,26,16,9,5›, the panel width (max 720) is divided by each cell size and the canvas redraws at that width, jumping ahead every given number of seconds, then clears the canvas at the end (same mosaic coarseness whatever the panel size)

use: · In steps:
note: If the photo comes from another origin (external URL without CORS) the canvas just gets tainted but drawing still works. If the photo has no src yet, nothing is applied

from.where: index.js mosaic (.js-pixel five work photos) — 18px→original width, progress^2.5, 1.5s, 1.1→1, top center
